description:
FILED s471 (Fable, 2026-09-06) from the USER design ask; the design is docs/plan-cache-and-install-s471.md sections 1 and 1.4 -- read it whole first.

SCOPE (one Opus agent, after s470bw #1261 merges -- same files):
 * pcl --cache-info: cache dir, size + count per kind, the core this run uses (installed/cached/source) and why, the compile policy IN EFFECT (resolved PCL_COMPILE_DIRS / PCL_NO_COMPILE_DIRS with their source: default/env).
 * pcl --no-cache (this run: *pcl-skip-cache* t); pcl --version (PCL version from the tag/CHANGELOG, cache generation, SBCL version, PPI version); pl2cl --help (today: Unknown option: help).
 * #1303: *pcl-cache-dir* computed at process START from PCL_CACHE_DIR (init hook), never at load/core-build; every cache path derives from it at call time (xs/, proto/ via pl2cl already do).  Guard row: PCL_CACHE_DIR=tmpdir -> the module .lisp/.fasl land THERE (the probe in the plan doc, F1).
 * F2: drop age from validity (bw did it) and make p-cleanup-old-cache prune by LAST USE: touch the entry on a HIT when its mtime is > 1 day old (sb-posix:utime), prune entries unused > 30 days; proto/ the same (#682 folds in).  Measure the touch cost (one syscall per module load).
 * F8: create the cache dir 0700; refuse LOUDLY (rule 12, perl-shaped die) a cache dir owned by another user or group/world-writable -- a fasl is code.
 * F7: modules under <cache>/modules/ if bw did not do it (a generation bump is NOT needed: the path changes, the key does not).
 * pcl --help: the Startup cache section becomes Caches (three env vars, four flags); pcl --clear-cache help says XS artifacts are not a cache (pcl-xs-install --clean); tools/install-pcl --help gains the caches paragraph; README Caches and switches rewritten (three short paragraphs + link to docs/caching.md, which #1262 writes after this).

BARS: gate; corpus-diff IDENTICAL (no emission change); the full sweep (cl/ change); Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t rows for --no-cache, PCL_CACHE_DIR, the prune, the 0700 refusal (inverse-verified); tools/ir-host-leak.pl; PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 diff for pcl before/after.

NOT in scope: the install layout (#1302), the root-script move (#1301), the docs page itself (#1262).
=== DONE (s470by) ===

SHIPPED in five commits on main 31473881 (rebased clean): items A-D (the
runtime + the two Perl-side readers + the four commands), item E (README and
ir-spec 9.2b), the *pcl-current-package* fix the sweep found, and #1338 in two
rounds (absorbed under the filler rule -- the same mechanism this batch
rewrote).

A / #1303 -- WHERE THE CACHE IS, IS A FACT ABOUT THE PROCESS.  %p-default-cache-dir
called from an sb-ext:*init-hooks* entry (the shape $$, the FP modes, the standard
handles and PCL_RAW_ELEMS already use); the defparameter INITFORM used to run when
the runtime LOADS, which on the normal path is when a saved CORE is built.  Probe:
before, PCL_CACHE_DIR=<tmp> put proto/ in the tmpdir and the module .lisp in
~/.pcl-cache (530 -> 533 files); after, ~/.pcl-cache unchanged -- and a core BUILT
with PCL_CACHE_DIR=A and RUN with =B writes into B.  ONE Perl-side reading:
PCLPaths::cache_root (+ cache_root_source), called by pcl, PCLSbcl::core_cache_dir
and Pl::ProtoCache::cache_dir (three copies before, plus the runtime's fourth).

B / F2 + #682 -- AN ENTRY IS KEPT WHILE IT IS USED, NOT WHILE IT IS YOUNG.
Validity is #1261's manifest only, so the age rule is disk hygiene:
%p-note-cache-use re-stamps the .lisp, the .deps and this runtime's .fasl TOGETHER
(the prune reads each file's own mtime; half an entry is not an entry), at most
once a day per entry and once per source per process; p-cleanup-old-cache drops
what nothing reached for 30 days (*pcl-cache-max-age*), in modules/ AND proto/.
MEASURED, which is why the scan is claimed once a day through a .last-prune stamp
(temp + rename(2)): 590 module files 7.0 ms + 1112 proto files 14.0 ms = 21 ms per
scan, warm, on EVERY miss.  The touch is one utime(2) = 0.0020 ms.

C / F8 -- THE ROOT IS CREATED 0700 AND AN UNSAFE ONE IS REFUSED (rule 12), naming
the directory, the mode and `chmod 700 DIR`; only the ROOT is asked.  This box's
~/.pcl-cache was 0775 and was fixed.  The refusal then fired for real on this
session's first cold board run, on a cache dir made by hand with mkdir under the
usual 0002 umask -- a directory PCL creates itself is 0700 and never hits it.

D -- THE COMMANDS.  pcl --cache-info (45 ms warm; the compile-policy line comes
from the RUNTIME's p-cache-info because the two dir lists are realpath'd at call
time, the core line from PCLSbcl), pcl --version (64 ms), pcl --no-cache, pl2cl
--help.  AND --no-cache USED TO SKIP READS ONLY: *pcl-skip-cache* still WROTE the
.lisp and its manifest (measured: 2 files), so %p-load-module-uncached now
transpiles to a temp outside the cache, loads it and deletes it.

THE SWEEP FOUND A BUG IN THAT NEW PATH AND ONLY THE SWEEP COULD:
%p-load-module-uncached returned EARLY from p-load-module-cached and so skipped
its (*pcl-current-package* *pcl-current-package*) rebinding -- a module's package
leaked into the caller and later unqualified names resolved in the wrong one
(hexfp.t 107 -> 100, sub.t 53 -> 51, every moved row got=undef).  The whole
perl-tests sweep runs with *pcl-skip-cache*, which is why the gate was blind.

BARS.  Gate 216 files / 7517 rows, Result FAIL = only the 13 pclxs xs rows, only the 13 pclxs xs rows; grep -a -c write-date over the whole
gate log = 0 (that is #1338's acceptance).  Full sweep --jobs 4: TOTAL passing
baseline 18647, current 18647 (+0); 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST; drops 5 = census;
GATE clean.  corpus-diff cd34df72 AND 31473881: emission IDENTICAL over 111 files,
silent drops 5 unchanged (no emission change => NO generation bump).
ir-host-leak.pl byte-identical to a cd34df72 extraction (31 leaked symbols over
111 files, both).  CPAN board 14 dists COLD and WARM: 183/183 rows identical to
baselines/cpan-board14-s467.tsv and to each other.  Companion --jobs 1 over
op/do.t op/inccode.t op/incfilter.t op/require_errors.t comp/require.t: the first
four = snapshot; comp/require.t 911/836 here and the BASE extraction reads
911/836 parallel / 909/838 serial on ONE tree, so its own spread -- NOT
attributable, snapshot NOT edited.  Timings warm best-of-5 x2 (box load 6.9-7.6):
use Moo 435/438 -> 455/421 ms, use JSON::PP 1476/1422 -> 1396/1399 ms = noise.
SBCL command line byte-identical before/after but for the core NAME and the
per-run /tmp names.  tag-license --check exit 0.

GUARDS.  Pl/t/cache-surface-01.t NEW (50 rows) + Pl/t/module-fasl-cache-01.t
42 -> 49, inverse-verified on a `git archive cd34df72` extraction.

FILED ON THE WAY: #1315 (pcl ignores PCL_SHOW_SBCL; it prints under -v only).
